title: Projecting people on a reference: shrinkage
description: Two populations. A reference of people defines the axes. A study of the same size is projected on them, and it does not change the axes. The sliders set the number of reference people in each population and the Fst between the populations. When the reference is small, the projected study people lie closer to the centre than the reference people do.

stats.label: Gap between the study groups on PC1 divided by the gap in the reference (1 = no shrinkage)
